name: program-runtime.validation-sweep
purpose: Read the latest recorded test-genie validation run for each scenario in a set and report which are passing, naming any not passing or never validated, so a supervisor runs one program instead of one validation lookup per scenario.

scenarios.description: Comma-separated scenario slugs to read validation state for. Defaults to the delivery/product scenario set.

assumptions: the latest recorded test-genie run per scenario is reachable through the validate runtime verb; when it is not, that scenario's read is reported unavailable, never as a passing or failing verdict
this program reads recorded run rows only; it never starts a validation run
invariants: no binding with effect write or destructive is called
no validation run is started; only the latest recorded run is read
at most one validate read is issued per requested scenario
a failed read for one scenario is isolated and reported unavailable; it never aborts the sweep
the envelope is printed exactly once, on every path
at most 32 requested scenarios are reported; the request is truncated with truncated=true

status.note: ok when every requested scenario's latest run was readable (not-passing and never-validated are domain signals, not failures); partial when at least one read was unavailable; unavailable when every read was unavailable; failed only on invalid input.

signals.requested: count of scenario slugs after truncation
signals.found: count of requested scenarios with a recorded latest run that was readable
signals.passing: count of requested scenarios whose latest recorded run is passing
signals.attention: list of {name, status, run_id} for requested scenarios whose latest run is not passing or which have no recorded run
signals.unavailable: count of requested scenarios whose validation read could not be performed (treat as unknown, never as zero)
signals.truncated: true when more than 32 slugs were requested

outputs.evidence: validate:<scenario> markers and test-genie-run:<id> for each readable latest run

fixtures.note: Reads the latest recorded test-genie run per scenario through the validate verb. When that history is unreachable the per-scenario read is unavailable and the sweep returns partial or unavailable; that is the honest unknown, not a program defect.
An empty scenario set after trimming is an invalid input the program reports as failed with class invalid_input before any read.
